Bands.description: Half-open [Min,Max) tiers that must tile the score scale contiguously; the top band is inclusive.

DeadbandDelta.description: Minimum score movement before a band transition is reported.

PriorScoreColumn.description: Column on the scored record holding the PREVIOUS score. Without it a band crossing cannot be detected — a first-ever score and a crossing look identical.

PriorBandColumn.description: Column holding the previously-assigned band label, compared against the new one to detect a crossing.
